ITEM.PTXT: A PCV hose and PCV valve are provided to forcibly introduce blow-by gas into the intake system and burn it, preventing blow-by gas containing large amounts of HC from being released into the atmosphere.
Under light load, blow-by gas is drawn into the surge tank by intake manifold vacuum through the PCV valve.
Under heavy load, the introduction of fresh air is stopped to handle a large flow of blow-by gas.
